Catherine SPINDLER (Président Europe & Middle East SEPHORA)
Today, I’m so proud to open an exciting new chapter for European beauty innovation !

At SEPHORA , we have always been passionate about discovering and nurturing the brands that will define what's next in beauty. That's why we announce the launch of the Sephora Prize for European Beauty Incubation.

Europe is home to an extraordinary wealth of beauty talent, creativity and innovation. Through the Sephora Prize, we aim to support and elevate the next generation of European beauty brands, helping them scale through Sephora's expertise, mentorship, visibility and unique community of beauty lovers.

Our ambition is simple: to help Europe's most promising brands grow beyond their home markets, shine across the region, and reach their full potential.
Applications are now open until July 6, and full details are available on our Sephora website.

I look forward to discovering the visionary founders and brands shaping the future of beauty. 
Together, let's celebrate and champion European beauty excellence !

Can’t wait !
